title: Transfer - Reservoir Spillway Alert Board
goal: Process hourly reservoir level records with action, flood, and major thresholds, then write `/root/output/spillway_alerts.json` summarizing each reservoir that crossed flood stage with flood-risk days, highest severity reached, and the peak day.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same skill into reservoir operations. The task still depends on comparing observed levels to staged thresholds, counting flood days, and assigning severity bands, so flood-detection remains the sole key capability being exercised.
